summary: Assert the loaded instruction/configuration set at session start rather than assuming it: in Claude Code run `/context` and check the 'Memory files' list, enable the `InstructionsLoaded` hook to log which instruction files loaded and why, and treat the documented stderr lines ('this workspace has not been trusted', 'headersHelper not run') as a failure signal in automation; in CI, fail the run when the expected project instruction file or MCP server is absent from the loaded set instead of proceeding with silently reduced configuration.

evidence.summary: Documents /context 'Memory files' as the way to confirm a CLAUDE.md actually loaded ('If a file is missing there, Claude can't see it') and the InstructionsLoaded hook to log exactly which instruction files are loaded, when they load, and why.

Names the exact machine-detectable signals emitted when configuration is withheld: a stderr 'this workspace has not been trusted' warning for skipped allow rules, a per-server 'headersHelper not run' line, and debug-log lines naming the trust key for skipped subagent hooks and inline MCP servers.

conditions: Automated or headless agent runs where nobody watches the terminal
Repositories whose conventions depend on project instructions, rules, or MCP servers actually being loaded
Debugging 'the agent ignored our CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md' reports
not_applicable_when: Surfaces with no equivalent introspection command or hook (verification then has to be inferred from behavior)
One-off interactive sessions where the cost of a check exceeds the cost of noticing the problem

expected_effect.primary: A withheld configuration becomes a visible, attributable failure at session start instead of a silent behavioral drift discovered later in review, cutting the misdiagnosis loop where teams rewrite instructions that were never read.

risks: The InstructionsLoaded hook and /context are Claude Code-specific; other surfaces need a different probe
Hook output adds noise and, if written into context, cost
A passing load check says the file entered context, not that the model followed it
revalidate_when: Claude Code changes /context or the InstructionsLoaded hook contract
Codex or another surface adds an equivalent loaded-instruction introspection
New trust-gating rows are added to the permissions matrix
